review_description: Knowledgeable about systems and local conditions. Efficient and did job on time. Organised grid connection. Very well mannered and effective staff.

Victor is very knowledgeable in solar systems.. We discussed our requirements and came up with a layout that worked the best for our home. The install ran smoothly over a couple of days and any questions we had during this process where answered. The guys on the roof where great, you could see they new what they were doing. Once the install was complete Victor made sure that the system was doing what it is designed to do.
Specialist, gave great comparisons,  explained the differences between inverters & solar panels & advised on the importance of quality rails & switch gear.

victor gave me the best and most informative quote. he came and installed the  system when he said he would.he also organised new meter and connection with Ergon Energy.I also was an electrician and data tech in my working life, and he and his crew are very good at what they do.                                                                                                                                                                        thank you.nick savino.

Victor was so prompt in visiting our home to talk us through the proposal. Victor was very informative.Victor had his team when arranged.Payment process was made easy and clear.We are yet to receive our first electricity account since installation of solar but we are sure we will have saved so much as we have had the larger solar systems on our previous homes.We would recommend 247 to any persons in the Hervey Bay Area.RegardsElizabeth

Got victor out to get quotes ,nothing was a bother for him, got a swag of different quotes from 5other companies, decided  on victor from 247energy as he made the whole process easy and was very informative giving us different options  on 6.6 to 12kw systems .we got a 10kw system and the whole process in installation was a pleasure.no dramas .I have already given his number to a family member who is going to get solar as well.i would not hesitate to recommend 247energy top blokes. .i don’t normally write reviews but I think I have to in this case (forgot to mention that his quotes came in cheeper  than competitors on the same systems) cheers
System fully discussed, gave us several options for panels/inverter.
Best in the business.. Simple.. easy.. perfect.....,,,,,........highly recommended.. nothing too much trouble.

Quoting was thorough, although a little slower than others due to heavy workload at the time. Quoting process was informative, including sample parts and was clear and personalised. Installation was smooth and professional.
Explained and showed samples of what is going to be installed.Installers were very good, polite, tidy and punctualThey take care of everything

Victor from 247 gave us a range of options with a great deal of additional information, including installation procedures and materials, allowing us to make a more informed decision. The other offers probably would have been just as good but they gave no indication on this aspect. Victor's telephone manner was great and his "pitch" about being an independant supplier was convincing.The other two offers were simply a range of options without much more, or indeed any, additional information. The only "backup info" was a page essentially saying, "here's the price, now sign the order". Not a good approach!

Victor explained the install in easy to understand language. He showed us examples of the equipment/hardware they use. After the quote was provided there was no pressure from him, follow up phone calls or pushy sales tactics.Connection to the grid all done hassle free.

247E was prompt and very professional with their visit and quote. Their installation was completed on the arranged day by competent and likeable tradesmen. The company organised all paperwork and arrangements with Ergon Energy who then installed a new meter for our grid connection.
installation went smoothly punctual neat tidy very nice guys and honest

On first contact we explained we would be moving into our house within three weeks and would Be in touch for a quote. We received a quote with lots of options and an explanation of how different systems worked. There was even a plan of the panels from google view. The installers were fantastic and worked in with other trades on site. They were very polite and tidy. Victor explained how the system worked after installation and contacted the energy company to arrange our new meter.We would recommend this company without hesitation.
Great job, offered me a solution for my hot water that other providers wouldn't, was very flexible with my needs as well

Victor answered all my questions and the quote he provided was more than reasonableInstallation was carried out at the date and time stated.installation was nest and tidy, the installation team a credit to Victor

Victor at 247 energy was great.  He reviewed our needs and recommended a system suited to our useage and budget.  We have been very happy with follow up as I had some questions and Victor was more than happy to assist even though he had well and truly finished the job and was already paid (as it was several weeks later).He not only beat the competition for the same system by about $400 cheaper but he was also able to install the system within a week and a half of us deciding to go ahead, so we had solar before x-mass, when the competition was saying not till after christmas.Victor provided exceptional service and was happy to answer all our questions and to explain in terms I could follow and understand the differences in panels and converters and batteries as well, as we are hoping to get batteries down the track. His information could all be verified on line and here on this site as well which made trusting him so much easier,  He really knew his stuff.  would recommend him to every one in Hervey Bay/maryborough/Fraser coast or sunshine coast.
The above comments are very much first impressions as the installation only took place yesterday. As a newby I still have much to learn.
Victor is the only person that tested with a meter our electrical system to ascertain if his solar installation would be successful

Thank you for putting trusted people forward. All were very good, but I like to deal with local guys if they are up to par, and Victor and his team were. You can publish my review, but please do not publish my name, just initials. I'll mark no below, so it is clear I don't want my name used. But you can pass my views on to Victor.Thanks

Victor did well in satisfying my main requirement which was to get the most KW as possible on our limited roof space. I am very happy with the quality of the system and the installation. I haven't had any post installation contact with him though. A follow up would normally be part of a good customer service schedule.

Still work outstanding after 4 weeks.
The experience was excellent. From order to installation was within 2 weeks and a very professional install along with friendly service. Good quality components were used.Highly recommended!
Overall we are very happy to recommend 247 Energy.
Would very highly recommend 247 Energy.  Not the cheapest but very high standard of workmanship. "Quality Remains Long Aftet Price is Forgotten.
